overview: The School Committee approved the consent agenda, tabled meeting minutes for revisions, welcomed new district administrators, and heard updates on the start of the school year and district operations, focusing on severe HVAC challenges across aging school facilities.

items.title: Good of the Order
items.summary: Members discussed designating a delegate for the upcoming MASC conference and preparing progress reports on committee goals.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved bills, payroll, and the regular meeting minutes from June 12, 2023.

items.title: Special Meeting Minutes
items.summary: Tabled minutes from July 19 and August 14, 2023, to the next meeting to allow for necessary edits.

items.title: Superintendent's Report
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent reported on school opening week, observed a moment of silence for September 11, and shared updates regarding athletics, school meals, and the transition to Blackboard Connect messaging.

items.title: Welcome of New Administrators
items.summary: The committee introduced new school principals, assistant principals, and district directors joining Medford Public Schools for the school year.

items.title: Operations Update
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent Cushing reviewed district operations, highlighting transportation staffing, safety protocols, playground upgrades, and widespread cooling system failures that require comprehensive capital replacement assessments.
